brief:
A Palestinian American candidate is running against Senator John Fetterman in Pennsylvania, casting the race as a referendum on the Democratic Party's approach to Israel, Middle East Eye reported. The challenger characterized the relationship between Palestinians and Israel as fundamentally broken, using the metaphor of divorce to describe the current state of affairs.

The race reflects growing tension within the Democratic Party over Middle East policy, with the challenger positioning himself as an alternative to what he describes as unconditional support for Israel among establishment Democrats like Fetterman.

title: Palestinian American challenges Pennsylvania senator over Israel stance
